Definition: Giddel, the name of one of the Nethinim, also of one of 'Solomon's servants'
BiblicalUsage: Giddel is a person named 4 times in Scripture, in Ezra and Nehemiah. The full story lives on the Giddel profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Giddel in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
